purpose: Separate frozen width tracking of its actual absolute twin-min TD residual target from alignment of that target with current-Q1 harmful optimism and action contrasts
post_hoc_status: Definitions fixed before new one-step evaluator calls, after previous development diagnostics. This is exploratory mechanism validation, not fresh confirmation or method selection.
development_inputs: Exact pinned existing full float64 states/time, float32 deployed action banks and saved current-policy continuation values, in original batch/state/candidate order. No new states, actions, prefixes or confirmation seeds.
fitting_bank_rule: Use the exact existing training scale-bank row indices in committed bindings.datasetidentity.split_receipt.scale_bank_training_row_indices. Recover observations/actions/reward/next observation/done from the pinned offline training transitions at those indices, and verify against exported scale-bank observations/actions/group IDs. No simulator calls for this bank.
fitting_bank_role: Training-distribution fitting diagnostic, not held-out calibration, fresh in-distribution validation, or empirical evidence of a conformal coverage guarantee. Multiple rows from one episode are dependent; report unique group count and group-weighted summaries separately.
one_step_rule: Exactly one source-faithful evaluator transition per existing development candidate, charged before dispatch. Preserve full physical state, pre-transition reward, deployed action, physics, next remaining-time encoding and finite-horizon terminal mask. Any live simulator verification consumes the same total cap; no extra verification transitions.
noise_rule: For each bank/draw generate jax.random.normal(jax.random.PRNGKey(seed), shape=(N,4), dtype=float32) once for the entire fixed bank, multiply by native noise_std .2, clip to[-.5,.5], add target actor action and clip to[-1,1]. No batching-dependent key splitting, checkpoint RNG advancement or noise-seed selection.
noise_interpretation: These are new declared native-operator draws, not reconstruction of the consumed original calibration refresh noise. Four draws describe only this finite noise bank, not an exact expected operator or four times as many independent episodes.
native_target: y_j=r+.98*(1-done)*min(Q1_target(next_obs, clipped_target_action_j), Q2_target(next_obs, clipped_target_action_j)), using the restored native target actor/critics and their unchanged normalization.
radius_definition: The selected direct_extension.live_width returns U=reference.threshold*reference.residual_scale*max(eta_reference(obs,action),1e-6). Despite its width name this is the residual radius; there is no factor2. Descriptive residual containment is abs(R_j)<=U, not U/2.
reference_snapshot: The final calibration refresh followed the final native current/target update and auxiliary fit at critic20000. Verify that boundary, finalrefresh counters and full-state/current-export equality. There is no independent stale critic snapshot in FrozenReference. At this boundary current critic equals the critic used by final refresh; reject unsupported boundaries.

terms.R_j: current twin-min Q minus native target y_j
terms.H: current Q1 minus current twin-min Q
terms.G_j: native target y_j minus saved deterministic current-actor continuation value V

accounting_identity: For every development candidate and draw, E=R_j+H+G_j. Construct all terms from the same replayed Q and y scalars converted to float64. Calibration uses abs(y-Qmin)=abs(R_j); changing residual orientation here only supports the exact accounting identity.
replay_rule: Replay frozen current actor/Q1/Q2/U and compare to saved inputs using the unchanged prior forward-check tolerance. Separately verify reconstructed native float32 target arithmetic with the same tolerance. Full state, optimizer state, reference, RNG and counters must remain unchanged.
accounting_rule: abs(E-(R+H+G)) <=64*eps_float64*(1+abs(E)+abs(R)+abs(H)+abs(G)) for every row/draw; this tight arithmetic check is distinct from float32 forward replay tolerance.
fitting_metrics: For each draw separately report descriptive row-level Pearson(U,abs(R)), residual-radius containment abs(R)<=U, unique episode count, row-weighted and equal-episode-group containment, residual and U magnitude. No held-out coverage claim or confidence interval.
development_metrics: For each draw report equal-state mean within-nine-action Pearson(U,abs(R)), Pearson(abs(R),signed E) and Pearson(abs(R),positive E). Report equal-state Pearson(U,signed E), Pearson(U,abs(E)), Pearson(U,positive E). Report state-centered action RMS and signed correlation with E for R,H,G, plus radius containment by state. Summarize all128 states, both batches, each time and all8cells without selecting favorable strata.
correlation_undefined_rule: Constant vectors produce undefined correlations with explicit reason/count; never replace undefined by zero. Positive E=max(E,0) can be constant. Each state has equal weight; candidate actions and smoothing draws are not independent episodes.
draw_summary: Preserve each of the four draw results plus descriptive mean/min/max across draws. Do not substitute abs(mean R) for mean abs(R), infer exact expected residuals, or use a favorable draw.
interpretation: Weak target tracking suggests limited width fit/generalization on that bank, not automatically a calibration theorem violation. Tracking its residual while poorly aligning with Q1 optimism supports a proxy-mismatch hypothesis. H/G accounting identifies algebraic differences, not causal proof that changing them improves decisions. G mixes target approximation, lag, smoothing and policy differences.
continuation_noise_note: Saved V is a deterministic numerical continuation conditional on state/action/current actor, with no Monte Carlo return sampling noise. New randomness here is native target-policy smoothing only. Numerical error, population variation and training-seed variation remain separate.
stop_rule: Abort on invalid source/checkpoint/runtime identity, unsupported reference boundary, nonfinite/unready reference, failed Q/U replay, state mutation, accounting error or exceeded transition/row/time budget. Otherwise finish the fixed summaries once, including unfavorable findings. No automatic fit, calibration change, production modification or training approval follows.
